title: A Dynamic Survey of Soft Set Theory and Its Extensions
abstract: arXiv:2602.21268v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Soft set theory provides a systematic framework for parameterized decision-making by associating each parameter with a subset of a given universe, thereby enabling structured representations of uncertainty [1, 2]. Over the past decades, the theory has evolved into a broad range of extensions, including hypersoft sets, superhypersoft sets, TreeSoft sets, bipolar soft sets, and dynamic soft sets, while also establishing connections with various mathematical disciplines, particularly topology and matroid theory. This book presents a comprehensive survey of soft set theory and its principal extensions, with particular emphasis on parameter spaces, value spaces, representative mathematical constructions, and the underlying assumptions necessary for rigorous comparisons among different frameworks. translated_title: 软集理论及其扩展的动态综述
translated_abstract: 软集理论通过将每个参数与给定论域的子集相关联，为参数化决策提供了一个系统性的框架，从而实现对不确定性的结构化表示 [1, 2]。在过去几十年中，该理论已发展出广泛的扩展形式，包括超软集、超超软集、TreeSoft 集、双极软集和动态软集，同时还与多个数学学科建立了联系，特别是拓扑学和拟阵理论。本书对软集理论及其主要扩展进行了全面的综述，特别强调参数空间、值空间、具有代表性的数学构造，以及在不同框架之间进行严格比较所必需的基本假设。书中仔细区分了文献中已确立的定义与探索性的表述，并批判性地审视了……的局限性（摘要内容在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文全面综述了软集理论及其主要扩展（包括超软集、TreeSoft 集、双极软集和动态软集等），系统梳理了参数空间、值空间与代表性数学构造，为不同框架间的严格比较奠定了基础。
